sources.snippet: MedGemma is a collection of Gemma 3 variants trained for performance on medical text and image comprehension to accelerate the building of healthcare-based AI applications. MedGemma comes in a 4B multimodal version, a 27B text-only version, and a 27B multimodal version, with multimodal versions utilizing a SigLIP image encoder trained on de-identified medical data. sources.snippet: The MedGemma collection contains Google's most capable open models for medical text and image comprehension, built on Gemma 3. Developers can use MedGemma to accelerate building healthcare-based AI applications.
